notes: The median per-cell count of 75 (IQR 48–102) is ~7–10× higher than the expected ~10 discrete Pol2 foci per nucleus; the montage confirms that the detector is picking up small, dim, noise-like puncta scattered throughout the nucleoplasm rather than a small number of bright, discrete clusters. Raising the intensity threshold and minimum object size should suppress diffuse/noisy signal and recover the expected sparse, bright foci pattern.
